howBody: Rows are your hand and columns are the dealer's face-up card. A hard total has no ace counted as 11; a soft total includes an ace counted as 11 (A+6 is soft 17). If you hold two cards of the same rank, use the pairs table first. After you hit and have three or more cards, doubling and surrender are no longer available, so follow the 'otherwise' action.
q1: What does GTO mean in blackjack?
a1: GTO (game theory optimal) is a poker term. In blackjack the dealer follows fixed rules, so the optimal strategy is simply the play with the highest expected value for each hand – known as basic strategy. These charts show exactly that.
q2: Does the strategy change with the table rules?
a2: Yes. The number of decks, whether the dealer hits soft 17, whether you can double after splitting, surrender, and whether the dealer takes a hole card all change some decisions. That is why every rule combination has its own chart here.
q3: Can basic strategy beat the casino?
a3: No. Perfect basic strategy reduces the house edge to roughly 0.5% under good rules, but the casino still has the advantage. No strategy guarantees a profit.
a4: Each chart is computed by an open-source engine that calculates the exact expected value of every action with cards removed from a finite shoe. It assumes no resplitting and one card on split aces. The code is on GitHub.
